thingsToDo.title: Visit Joshua Tree National Park
thingsToDo.description: Joshua Tree National Park is a park in Joshua Tree, California. Joshua Tree National Park (West Entrance) is the classic gateway into the Mojave-and-Colorado Desert landscapes that surround Joshua Tree. Drive in at sunrise for low-angled light on the namesake trees, then pause at pullouts for boulder gardens and sweeping desert views. It is the best starting point for a half-day loop that keeps you close to town while still.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Hidden Valley
thingsToDo.description: Hidden Valley is a park in Joshua Tree, California. Hidden Valley is one of the most iconic short loops in Joshua Tree, tucked inside a bowl of granite boulders and desert flora. The trail is easy but dramatic, with narrow passages, rock piles, and classic Joshua tree silhouettes that make it feel like a natural amphitheater. Plan to linger for photos and sunset light that warms the surrounding stone.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Joshua Tree Visitor Center
thingsToDo.description: Joshua Tree Visitor Center is a park in Joshua Tree, California. Joshua Tree Visitor Center is the essential first stop for maps, ranger tips, and current trail conditions before you head into the park. The exhibits give quick context on desert ecosystems, while the nearby shops make it easy to stock up on last-minute supplies. It is a practical, time-saving stop that helps you plan a smart loop day.

thingsToDo.title: Visit Noah Purifoy Outdoor Desert Art Museum
thingsToDo.description: Noah Purifoy Outdoor Desert Art Museum is a cultural attraction in Joshua Tree, California. Noah Purifoy Outdoor Desert Art Museum is an open-air sculpture field showcasing large-scale assemblage works spread across the high desert. The walk-through layout lets you take in the installations at your own pace, with mountain backdrops that make the art feel even more dramatic. Give yourself time to wander the paths and spot the surprising details.
